visualCharacteristics.purpose: Side-by-side columns of content; with 'alternating', image/text rows whose sides alternate; with 'curve', the page header (H1 and intro beside a photo with a curved corner)
visualCharacteristics.layout: Cells sit side by side from 900px and stack on mobile
visualCharacteristics.alternating: Image/text rows on white; the image side follows the authored cell order from 900px (image cell first = image left); image stacks above the text on mobile. A poster image with a YouTube link shows a blue circular play button and opens the video in a modal dialog
visualCharacteristics.curve: Page header (formerly Hero (page)): 40% text / 60% photo from 900px, photo fills the row height; the photo has one curved corner facing the text (--radius-media / --radius-media-mirror). Cell order sets the side: text first = photo right, photo first = photo left. Mobile: full-width photo above centered text

contentPattern.structure: one row per line of columns, one cell per column. With 'alternating': each row has a media cell (image, optionally followed by a youtube.com/watch link for a video) and a text cell (optional H3, paragraphs, lists, links); the cell order sets the side: image cell first = image left, text cell first = image right. With 'curve': each row has a text cell (H1, intro paragraphs) and a photo cell; the cell order sets the photo side
contentPattern.example: Row 1: poster image + https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R2OGCW75eaY | paragraphs, bullet list, bold link 'View our current internship opportunities'

notes: Growth & development internship program row with a video poster: authored as 'Columns (alternating)'
Our workplace model two image/text rows: authored as 'Columns (alternating)'

Page headers of the section pages (life-at-blue-shield, our-workplace-model, a-culture-of-belonging, growth-development, total-rewards, how-to-get-hired, events, blog): authored as 'Columns (curve)', text cell first (photo right); formerly 'Hero (page)'
Since 2026-11-03 the alternating image side follows the cell order (was odd/even rows); our-workplace-model row 2 authored text first to keep its layout

reuseGuidance: Use 'Columns (alternating)' for stacked image/text rows that swap sides; The cell order sets the side: image cell first = image left, text cell first = image right (swap the cells on every other row for a zigzag). Put a YouTube link under the image to turn it into a video play button. Plain 'Columns' keeps the boilerplate behaviour. Use 'Columns (curve)' for the page header at the top of section pages: put the text cell first for the photo on the right, the photo cell first for the photo on the left.
